description:
From the fz-kdt.120 cold review (2026-09-03): with 120's prototype applied,
fixtures2/behavior/enum_tier0.fz -- one of the three known-red matrix fixtures
-- runs on all three doors and its stdout matches enum_tier0.expected.txt
byte for byte, but it emits a NEW warning[type/no-matching-clause] at
runtime:Enum.fz:267 (Enum.member_result/3), the fixture has no
.expected.diagnostics, and warnings are errors when we control them. So the
last thing between that fixture and green is a library clause coverage
question in Enum.member_result/3: either a clause is genuinely missing for a
row the analysis now reaches (fix the library) or the row is a phantom joined
across users (the same blind-activation family as the List.reduce_step/3
ticket). Measure which, on 120's branch, before touching either. Also: under
the prototype enum_tier0 becomes a FIFO/LIFO canon mover (2413 lines, all
executable numbering / callee ids, stdout identical) -- classify that with
the same probe. Sequence: on fz-kdt.120's landing.

comments.text: SAME CLASS AT HEAD, not only under 120 (fz-kdt.124 cold review, 2026-09-03): warning[type/no-matching-clause] from runtime:Enum.fz:320 and :323 fires on ANY Enum.with_index program at 8de517a28 (e.g. the two-user with_index reproducer). Library clause coverage warnings we control are errors; measure with the same probe as the member_result/3 case and decide fix-the-library vs phantom-joined-row for each site.

title: enum_tier0 prints the oracle exactly once fz-kdt.120 lands but stays red on a warning[type/no-matching-clause] at Enum.member_result/3 (runtime:Enum.fz:267)
